seams.title: Make 'has convoke' a readable property and let a next-spell promise grant convoke
seams.clause: "The next spell you cast this turn has convoke." / "Whenever you cast a spell that has convoke, …" / "Whenever you cast another spell that has convoke, …"
seams.why: game.NextSpellPromise carries Improvise but no Convoke (game/next_spell_promise.go improvisePromiseCostLocked); add the convoke twin. No predicate tells a trigger that the spell being cast has convoke, whether printed (Spec tap cost effects.Convoke()), granted by a static (game.GrantedTapCost / SpellsYouCastHaveConvoke) or granted by a promise; expect one engine read on the cast event or stack item plus a CastTrigger filter in cards/effects. Caetus's static itself is the existing SpellsYouCastHaveConvoke(SpellIs(noncreature)); it is here because its spells must count as 'having convoke' for the three triggers.
seams.checked: grep 'next spell you cast this turn has convoke' effects: 0 (archway_of_innovation.go does improvise via GrantNextSpellPromise{Improvise:true}); grep -i convoke game/next_spell_promise.go: 0; grep 'has convoke', 'cast a spell that has convoke', 'spell with convoke' effects: 0; grep HasConvoke|hasConvoke game+effects: 0.

seams.title: Let a spell planeswalk or make chaos ensue after a vote, and add the planar-die extra roll
seams.clause: "Will of the Planeswalkers — Starting with you, each player votes for planeswalk or chaos. If planeswalk gets more votes, planeswalk. If chaos gets more votes or the vote is tied, chaos ensues." / "If you would roll one or more planar dice, instead roll that many planar dice plus one and ignore one."
seams.why: 'Chaos ensues' exists only as the planar die's chaos face (WheneverChaosEnsues watches EventRollDie with PlanarFaceChaos); a resolving spell saying 'chaos ensues' (CR 311.7, 901.9b) has no emitter, so chaos abilities cannot be triggered by an effect. PlaneswalkForEffect exists (game/planeswalk.go) and voting exists (ADR 0146), so the vote is composition. Ichor Elixir needs a static replacement on planar-die rolls; game/dice_roll.go has only the one-shot ModRollExtraDieIgnoreOne. Also decide and state what these clauses do in a game with no planar deck (expected: nothing).
seams.checked: grep -i 'chaos ensues|ChaosEnsue' game/*.go: only the die comment in planechase_die.go; planes_b1_helpers.go comment 'No card of the catalog yet says chaos ensues as an effect'; grep 'will of the planeswalkers' effects: 0; grep 'plus one and ignore' effects: 0; 'planeswalk.' as an effect only in bad_wolf_bay.go / effects_planechase.go.

seams.title: Record and expose that a creature attacked a battle
seams.clause: "This creature has indestructible as long as it attacked a battle this turn." / "Whenever this creature attacks a battle, …" / "If it's attacking a battle, put a +1/+1 counter on it instead."
seams.why: The turn tally knows that a creature attacked and which players (game/turn_tally.go AttackedThisTurn, AttackedPlayersThisTurn) but not that the attack target was a battle; War Historian's static needs that fact after combat. 'Attacks a battle' and 'is attacking a battle' can be read today from Card.AttackingTarget + ClassifyAttackTargetForEffect (game/attack_target.go), but no card does it, so the same worker should add the one shared predicate/trigger shape and the tally field together.
seams.checked: grep 'attacks a battle', 'attacked a battle', 'as long as it attacked', "if it's attacking a" effects: 0 each; 'attacking a battle' appears only in comments excluding battles (mage_slayer.go, soc_b14_helpers.go); grep 'func (g \*Game) Attacked' game: no battle variant.

seams.title: Add protection from colorless as a quality and as a choice
seams.clause: "Target creature or planeswalker you control gains protection from colorless or from the color of your choice until end of turn."
seams.why: game/protection.go's ProtectionQualityKind has Color, AnyColor, Monocolored, multicolored, card type, subtype, mana value … but no colorless quality (CR 702.16a allows any characteristic value); parseQuality mints no token for a quality it cannot parse. The choose-a-colour prompt (color_choice.go protectionFromChosenColor, center_soul.go) needs a sixth option.
seams.checked: grep -i colorless game/protection.go: 0; grep 'protection from colorless', 'from colorless' effects: 0; 9 files with 'protection from the color of your choice' (center_soul.go, blessed_breath.go, emerge_unscathed.go).

seams.title: Mark backup abilities on the stack so a trigger can see one targeting a creature
seams.clause: "Whenever a creature you control becomes the target of a backup ability, copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy. This ability triggers only once each turn."
seams.why: EventBecomesTarget carries StackItemID and TargeterKind (spell / activated / triggered) but nothing identifies the triggered ability as backup; Backup() in soc_b6_helpers.go is an ordinary WhenThisEnters whose only mark is its label text. Expect a keyword tag on TriggeredAbility/StackItem set by Backup(), then CopyAbility{ItemID} (ability_copy.go) does the copy; the copy must still grant the ORIGINAL source's abilities.
seams.checked: grep 'becomes the target of a backup ability', 'backup ability' effects: 0; grep IsBackup|AbilityTag|AbilityKeyword game: 0; ability copy exists (ability_copy.go, 8 files with 'copy that ability. You may choose new targets'); once-per-turn: docs/adding-cards.md 'This ability triggers only once' (#5245).

seams.title: Track whether a player was dealt combat damage since their last turn

The front face (choose one or both — destroy all legendary / nonlegendary creatures) needs no engine work but declares its Sweep.
